container_details.notes: The FSC certification applies to the cardboard core, which is made from recycled materials. The plastic sides are 100% recycled polycarbonate. recycled_pct for the whole spool is not stated. Source: a brand-wide spool statement in the PLA Recycled launch post.
container_details.source_quote: The cardboard we use is FSC certified , it is made from recycled materials and can be further recycled. … This Summer, we started manufacturing the plastic spool sides from a 100% recycled polycarbonate (PC).
